about: GeM catalogue uploads happen in the portal's own form: General Information > catalogue information > offer quantity and price > product specification > images. This sheet gathers those values in that order.
Per GeM's seller FAQ, GSTIN is not mandatory to register, and a personal PAN can be used for identity verification.
Put material and size in GeM's specification fields, not only in the description.
Yellow cells are details KaarigarAI doesn't collect: fill them in the portal.

columns.note: GeM accepts registered, unregistered or unbranded; change it if you have a brand
GeM's FAQ says to enter — when there's no model number

columns.not_collected: the GST HSN code for your product (mandatory on GeM)
